In the midterm elections on Tuesday, U.S. voters face another test - of our
values, judgment, and commitment to defending the American experiment. It
ought to be easy.

In recent years, we've flunked. Despite his obvious unfitness, Americans
handed Donald Trump the presidency in 2016. Even after he incited a violent
insurrection against the constitutional transfer of power, we handed it back
in 2024.

But things have changed dramatically in two years. Trump has shown
unmistakably that he poses the threat to liberty, security, and prosperity
that the American Founders feared.
